source_title: Schools and Other Institutions Calendar for 2026
day_count_method: Inclusive count of every calendar date from the start date through the end date, including both ends, weekends and public holidays. This matches the circular's note that the days it records include public holidays and weekends.

conflicts.source_title: Schools and Other Institutions Calendar for 2026
conflicts.note: Primary and secondary table, page 1: Monday 2nd February, 2026 to Friday 1st May, 2026, printed as 89 days. An inclusive count of those two dates is 89. Closing date is Friday 1st May, 2026.

conflicts.source_title: Observance of the Official Calendar for Education Institutions for the Academic Year 2026
conflicts.note: The letter says the calendar gives the opening and closing of the school terms and institutional semesters as 2nd February 2026 and 1st May 2026. Those two dates match Term I in the calendar. The letter does not restate Term II or Term III and does not print a day count.

conflicts.source_title: Official Announcement on the Re-opening of All Schools and Education Institutions
conflicts.note: Directs schools to reopen on Tuesday 10th February 2026 and says Term 1 runs from that Tuesday to Friday 1st May 2026. The announcement does not print a replacement day count. An inclusive count of 10 February 2026 through 1 May 2026 is 81. That 81 is a count of the dates the announcement prints, not a figure the announcement states, and it is not chosen here. The closing date matches the calendar.

holidays.name: 2nd Term Holidays
holidays.note: The primary and secondary holiday table prints the start as 22nd August, 2025 and the end as 13th September, 2026, and prints 23 days. An inclusive count from 22 August 2025 through 13 September 2026 is 388 days, not 23. An inclusive count from 22 August 2026 through 13 September 2026 is 23 days. The start date is left null because the printed year and the printed day count disagree. This file does not pick one. The printed holiday total of 104 matches 23 + 23 + 58, which is consistent with the day count and not with a start in 2025.

notes: Primary source is the scanned circular Schools and Other Institutions Calendar for 2026, dated 24th November 2025, reference ADM/085/157/01, published on the ministry school-calendars page as the file dated 06/01/2026.

Term dates in this file are the primary and secondary school table only. The same PDF also prints calendars for health training, skills centres, technical institutes, teacher colleges and a national physical education and sports list. Those rows were not copied. The sports pages could not be read row by row with confidence from the scan.

The circular says the national examination dates are among the activities whose dates are communicated later, and that not every activity is printed. No national examination period is dated in the primary and secondary section, so none is invented here.

The circular tells headteachers of boarding schools in the Kampala city metropolitan area to stagger starting and closing dates for different classes over two to three days. That is an instruction inside the official term, not a second set of term dates, so it is not entered as a conflict.

The 6 January 2026 observance letter and the 16 January 2026 reopening announcement are separate official PDFs on the same ministry page. They are cited only where they speak to a term date. Term I opening is the only date on which they disagree with each other or with the calendar.
Third Term agrees with the product owner's known check: Monday 14 September 2026 to Friday 4 December 2026, 82 days. Nothing was changed to force that check.
